nw: NW is the compass point midway between north and west.
NW means the same as northwest or nor'-west or northwestward.
nwbn: NWbN is the compass point that is one point north of northwest.
NWbN means the same as northwest by north.
nwbw: NWbW is the compass point that is one point west of northwest.
NWbW means the same as northwest by west.
